# blackboard-mcp

> Open-source MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Blackboard Learn (Ultra). It gives AI assistants (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex CLI, Cursor, VS Code, SlideMate) read-only access to a student's Blackboard courses, content, deadlines and announcements, and downloads this year's lecture slides. Uses Blackboard's REST API with the user's own browser session after university SSO + MFA sign-in; no API key or developer account needed. Works at Imperial College London (bb.imperial.ac.uk), Edinburgh (www.learn.ed.ac.uk), Bristol (www.ole.bris.ac.uk), Leeds, Sheffield, Southampton, York and any Blackboard Learn site via BB_BASE_URL. Python, MIT licence.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/Mattlo0546/blackboard-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, client configs, tools, universities, FAQ

## Tools
- bb_login, bb_status, bb_courses, bb_browse, bb_download, bb_upcoming, bb_announcements, bb_sync / bb_sync_status

## Install
- `uv tool install --managed-python https://github.com/Mattlo0546/blackboard-mcp/archive/refs/heads/main.zip`, then `BB_BASE_URL=<your blackboard> blackboard-mcp login`; run with `blackboard-mcp serve` (stdio)

- [canvas-mcp](https://github.com/Mattlo0546/canvas-mcp): Canvas LMS
- [moodle-mcp](https://github.com/Mattlo0546/moodle-mcp): Moodle (UCL, King's, LSE)
